newsitem.title: USA: SSE president resigns, Moore named CEO.
newsitem.headline: SSE president resigns, Moore named CEO.

text.p: SSE Telecom Inc said Thursday that it has named Daniel Moore as chief executive officer, effective immediately, and that its president, Frederick Toombs will resign, effective June 30.
The company said Moore has been its chief financial officer and executive vice president since February 1994.

Moore said one of the company's highest near-term priorities is to further expand the company's management team. "We expect to welcome additional senior operating, sales and marketing and engineering executives to the company in the future," Moore said in a company statement.
The company said Toombs would remain a member of the board and assist management during a transition period.

The company did not say who would succeed Toombs as president or whether Moore would remain chief financial officer after becoming chief executive. A call to the company for further information was not immediately returned.
SSE Telecom makes satellite earth station components.
